name: Menethil Keep
summary: Menethil Keep commands the skyline above Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Four watchtowers guard the Alliance port, and Captain Stoutfist leads its militia from within the stone walls.

sections.title: Bastion of the Harbor
sections.body: Menethil Keep rises over Menethil Harbor’s wooden docks and the Wetlands marshes. Four stone watchtowers overlook the town and bay, watching for seaward raiders, renegades, and swamp beasts pushing into the area. Within the fortress, Captain Stoutfist directs the town militia and organizes patrols to defend the port and protect Alliance interests across the region.

faq.q: What is Menethil Keep used for?
faq.answer: Menethil Keep houses the Menethil Harbor militia and the Alliance command post in the Wetlands. Captain Stoutfist leads the local garrison from its stone walls, directing the harbor’s defenses and organizing adventurers to face threats across the marsh.

faq.q: Who is in charge of Menethil Keep?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist commands Menethil Keep and the Menethil militia. He coordinates the harbor’s defense against Dark Iron dwarf raiders, marsh beasts, and pirates.
Menethil Keep stands inside Menethil Harbor on the Wetlands’ western coast. Its four tall stone towers rise above the settlement.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler arriving by ship from Kalimdor or heading north toward Ironforge and Arathi, you can look to Menethil Keep for the military protection of this vital transport hub.
